forecast: sqrt(252 * mean((sum(original_slot_weight * daily_adjusted_stock_return))**2)); 127 exact benchmark closes ending formation date; no demeaning
forecast_interpretation: Hypothetical constant-weight returns of the currently selected basket, not the historical realized strategy return series used in the paper
scale: min(1, .12/forecast); zero forecast means scale 1; no slots means cash
fixed_initial: For each signal separately, compute first formation scale once and reuse at every formation; no full-period fitting
monthly_risk: Recompute selected-basket forecast and scale on each of the eight original formation dates
unmanaged: Scale 1; must reproduce the four corresponding original cost-case ledgers and NAVs
execution: Original fixed basket targets times scale, entered at second later benchmark session close; no intervening risk trading
cost_model: Original self-financing post-cost equity solver on drifted stock notionals, including every change caused by scaling
cash: Zero interest; no leverage, shorting or borrowing
original_strategy: SM1 selectors, eligibility, eight dates and ten slots unchanged; monthly drift allowed
missing_inputs: HALT/FAIL with no full-period return, no interpolation or selection using future completeness
primary_comparison: For each signal at 5bp, monthly_risk versus unmanaged and fixed_initial: full-period return, observed drawdown; report 25bp stress too
secondary: actual notional turnover divided by initial capital
observed annualized daily standard deviation, descriptive not a guarantee
basket holding-interval positive counts, not independent trades or actual win rate
sample: Original 2025-04-30 signal through 2025-12-31 marks, first entry 2025-05-02
source_prices: Existing private retrospective vendor adjusted closes; not verified fills or broker accounting
literature: Barroso/Santa-Clara author manuscript November 2013 section 4 equations 5-6 via transcript; 2015 publication metadata; author-linked published-equation-10 errata. Published full article and replication package not obtained.
research_choices: Pure long high-beta basket backcast, unit scale cap, zero-interest cash, original two-session lag and fixed-initial-scale comparator are DX27 extensions
